claim_comment: Closing the observation contract only after proving retry-safe idempotency, mandatory exact coding scope, explicit unknown-extension handling, and a strict separation between admitted observations and provider-internal memory effects.
retry_note: The first evidence run rejected only a documentation phrase split by Markdown emphasis. The documentation now contains the exact canonical settlement wording; contract semantics and tests are unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Retrying the same observation cannot create a second effect.
Repository/worktree/session scope is mandatory for coding observations.
Unknown extensions are preserved or explicitly rejected.
The contract distinguishes observation from resulting memory records.
close_reason: Accepted the V1 committed-observation contract with exact coding scope, deterministic crash-safe idempotency, inert-or-explicit extension handling, and provider-effect semantics that do not equate observations with memory records.
close_comment: Evidence: product/contracts/memory-provider-v1/provider-observation-contract.json and its strict schema define immutable post-settlement envelopes carrying profile/project/repository/worktree/branch/session scope, canonical source receipts, payload and extension digests, provenance, privacy, ordering, deadline, and cancellation. Unknown optional extensions round-trip as opaque inert data, unknown required extensions fail explicitly, and no extension can activate behavior or mutate authority. Observation IDs are never provider memory IDs; one observation may produce zero, one, or many opaque provider-local effects and stable memory references remain optional. Idempotency keys include provider/registration/scope/source revision/payload/extension identity, survive retries and restarts, and require persisted provider deduplication; same key/same canonical content is duplicate acknowledgement, while divergent content is conflict. Delivery is at least once, out-of-order tolerant, batch-bounded, receipt-backed, and mechanically non-influential in observer mode. The validator and mutation tests enforce every acceptance criterion and cross-check the accepted registry and handshake contracts.
